scientific_integrity: Exact spherical and Grassmannian moment proof, standalone rational verification; finite numerical checks do not substitute for the analytic argument.
scientific_limitations: Local analytic comparison for one zonal degree-four harmonic path only; no full ten-dimensional monotonicity theorem, no universal local bound for other harmonics. Earlier unindexed derivations cannot be entirely ruled out.
title: Quartic positivity at the first critical affine-quermassintegral threshold
